title: RERA-Karnataka sanctioned-project FAR benchmark (ground-truth validation)
note: Validates far_assembly against REAL sanctioned projects — the ground-truth check no internal test replaces. cases[] is EMPTY until real RERA filings are supplied. Every real case MUST carry source_url (the RERA filing) + sanctioned_far read from it. NO project values are invented; example_shape rows below carry null real-values and only document the shape.

schema.source_url: string — the RERA-Karnataka filing URL (REQUIRED for a real case)
schema.sub_zone: string|null — e.g. Main / Mixed / Business / Central (needed to pick the FAR table)
schema.road_width_m: number — the abutting road width from the filing (treated as surveyed/authoritative)
schema.amalgamated: bool — true if the plot was amalgamated/reconstituted (Additional-FAR eligibility)
schema.sanctioned_far: number — GROUND TRUTH: the FAR the authority actually approved
schema.explanation: string|null — REQUIRED only when the sanctioned FAR does not match our computed line (premium/purchasable FAR used? corner plot? TDR? special zone? data error?)

match_rule: sanctioned_far is what the authority approved on the plot -> compare it to the ACHIEVABLE line: achievable_with_entitlements when amalgamated (entitlement claimed), else achievable_base. Match within +/- 0.05. A mismatch WITHOUT an explanation is a RED flag (fails loud) — that is how a composition bug is caught. Do NOT tune tolerance to hide mismatches.

example_shape.project_name: EXAMPLE — shape only, NOT a real project
example_shape.notes: EXAMPLE-SHAPE — all real-value fields null on purpose; fails the real-case guard. Replace with a real RERA filing (fill source_url + sanctioned_far read from it).

example_shape.project_name: EXAMPLE — amalgamated case shape, NOT real
example_shape.notes: EXAMPLE-SHAPE — amalgamated=true means the validator would compare achievable_with_entitlements. Real values null.
